name: dev_pilot
description: Matched development pilot for the midterm report. questions_per_dataset x datasets x (devices + controls) x models. All counts are DERIVED by scripts/build_dev_pilot.py --check; never edit counts by hand.
seed_note: Selection seed for the pilot manifest. Distinct from the 42 used by pilot/pilot_disjoint/screening4 so the pilot sample is a fresh deterministic draw, not a prefix of earlier pools.
devices_source: Must equal configs/device_selection.frozen.json retained_devices (verified by build_dev_pilot.py; mismatches are reported, never auto-fixed).

exclusions.policy: Exclude every example_id already used by any saved generation run under outputs/ (screening, controls, smoke runs, pilot_baseline) plus every ID named in earlier manifests (pilot.json, pilot_disjoint.json, screening4.json) -- i.e. anything used in screening or prompt development. Selection then draws from the full development pool (gsm8k train, logiqa_v2 validation), excluding items whose content occurs in the official test split and within-sample content duplicates.

generation.notes: Zero-shot, directly constrained generation. Identical questions across every model and condition. No demonstrations, output repair, or retries. Gold answers never enter prompts.
